connector.name: Census (ACS by ZIP)
connector.registryDescription: U.S. Census (ACS) data by ZIP: income, demographics, housing, education, from a local store.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcpwright-census. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mcpwright account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CENSUS_API_KEY
env.description: Free Census API key (get one at https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html). Required for the one-time bulk download of the ACS dataset.
